long_biography.plain_text:
A 1996 sailing sabbatical gave Fabio Cannavale the idea for Floating Village, a specialist boat-holiday venture. The Italian engineering graduate had previously worked in management consulting. He then helped establish eDreams in Italy before launching Volagratis as a low-cost flight search engine, translating his interest in travel into a scalable internet business.

Volagratis became the starting point for Bravofly Rumbo Group, which expanded across Europe and bought travel sites including Rumbo and Jetcost. The group listed in Zurich in 2014 and acquired lastminute.com the following year, adopting its name for the wider company. Cannavale later left executive leadership. Freesailors, the investment vehicle he controls, remains the listed company’s largest shareholder.

uncertainties.detail: The Royal Malta Yacht Club's official 2025 programme names Fabio Cannavale as owner of the exact 23.95-metre Lupa of the Sea in the source record. Italian nationality, Lugano-area location and Cannavale's independently documented sailing history converge strongly. Several unrelated people share the name on LinkedIn, but none matches this complete combination; no private vessel material enters either biography.

Cannavale now has a defining venture-capital role through B Heroes and holds other reported investments. The 2025 lastminute.com annual report nevertheless shows that he owns 93.71% of Freesailors, the listed travel-technology company's 38.65% largest shareholder. No complete personal balance sheet ranks every asset, so Technology and Founder follow the largest directly disclosed current interest; Finance & Investments and Investor remain material secondary descriptions rather than the primary classifications.

Public sources directly establish that Cannavale founded and built the online-travel platform behind his principal wealth. They do not establish the source of early venture capital, the materiality of any family platform or whether his start qualifies as independent or advantaged. Broad Self-made therefore records the positive creation mechanism without inventing a starting subtype.

A government publication establishes 18 April 1965 and Milan, Italy, while corporate sources corroborate the year and nationality. The saved Mr remains valid in the separate title field, but it is removed from the proposed display name because strong professional, corporate, government and sporting sources consistently use Fabio Cannavale. A commercial directory expands the name to Fabio Domenico Pasquale Cannavale, but no sufficiently authoritative corroboration was found, so middle names are not proposed.

No dedicated Forbes personal profile was found; Forbes Italia articles are treated only as reporting. The exact LinkedIn profile is strongly attributable through company, education, residence and biography details. Searches did not authenticate personal Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or a personal website, so only LinkedIn and B Heroes' official Company Website are proposed.

E-commerce captures the founder-built online booking and travel-retail platform, while Venture capital captures the separate sustained B Heroes mandate. The more precise Online travel concept exists only as inactive catalogue state and cannot be assigned. Angel investor would duplicate the venture-capital role, and Competitive sailing is omitted because the evidence establishes ownership and participation but not enough independent public salience for a minimum useful set. No company tag is invented.
